title: Synthetic Generative AI Content Safety Policy

sections.title: Pre-launch safety evaluation
sections.text: Public generative AI features must complete documented evaluations for prohibited content, prompt bypasses, harmful advice, impersonation, and foreseeable misuse before broad launch. Unresolved high-severity failures block launch.

sections.title: Reporting and incident response
sections.text: User-facing generative AI must provide an accessible harmful-output reporting mechanism, defined response ownership, severity-based response times, evidence preservation, and a process for updating filters and evaluations after incidents.

sections.title: Human review for published content
sections.text: AI-generated external marketing or authoritative content must be reviewed by an accountable person before publication. Reviewers must verify factual claims and reject health, financial, or legal claims that lack approved evidence.
